claims_in_paper.claim_text: synthesised evidence across transport modes and identified precipitation as the weather variable with the most consistent negative effect on road performance.
Traffic performance under adverse weather has been measured by average speed , travel time index , journey-time reliability , and composite resilience scores .
The speed-at-capacity reductions of 8--14\% reported by capture average effects during sustained rain, not the marginal effect per millimetre.
